title: Between Yesterday and Today
excerpt: This universal mission marked the boundary for all of creation between a dark, oppressive past and a brilliant, shining future, as well as a prosperous and exuberant present A clear announcement of a new order decreed by Allah, the all knowing, the all Wise. Its herald was Mohammed, the bringer of glad tidings and a warner. Its Book was the clear and Enlightening Qur'an. Its soldiers were the vanguards of the Emigrants and the Ansar (helpers) and those who followed them ...
author: ByHasan al-Banna
